Breakfast at the hotel. A guide awaits you in the lobby of the hotel. Half-day excursion (4h) to Sugarloaf (Pao de Azucar Mounain) with an English-speaking guide. You go to Praia Vermelha (Red Beach), from where you will take a cable car up the mountain. The first stop will be on Mount Urka, which has a wide observation deck where you can have a snack in a restaurant or bar. On Sugarloaf Mountain itself, there is a smaller platform, but it offers a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains, islands in the ocean, the Niterói Bridge, and the statue of Christ.

Then by car you will go to the central areas of old Rio, where you will admire several ancient churches, monasteries, the main Cathedral of the city, as well as buildings built in the colonial style.

blocks.text:
Half-day excursion (4h) to Corcaovado to the statue of Christ with an English-speaking guide  awaits you.Arrival at the station, from where an open, environmentally friendly train takes off, which heads through the jungle to the top of the Corcovado hill. On both sides of the railway, there are breathtaking views of the Tijuca forest, which is home to monkeys and other exotic animals and birds. At the top of the Corcovado hill, at an altitude of 700 m above sea level, rises the symbol of Rio - the statue of Christ the Savior (38 m),  which was erected in 1931. From the top of Corcovado, a breathtaking panorama of the metropolis and its surroundings opens: the Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, the world's largest stadium Maracanã, Sugarloaf and much more 

Additionally you can order a flight over Rio by helicopter - from 150 U$ We recommend ordering a flight for 250 USD/person 9/10 minutes with a flight around Jesus (the price is already with transfer) (min 4 people you will be put on board with other clients)

A helicopter flight gives you the opportunity to fully enjoy the beautiful views: the blue ocean, mountains overgrown with tropical greenery, snow-white beaches, yachts and the whole city: the statue of Christ the Savior, the Botanical Gardens, the lake, Niemeier Avenue, Leblond, Ipanema, Copacabana, Sugarloaf beaches. Duration from 10 to 30 minutes.
